name: A05 held-out pseudo-random-seed reproducibility certificate audit
status: post-A03 exploratory protocol locked before A05 runs
seed_space: uniform PRNG integers in [0,2^31), with replacement; reference seed excluded and redrawn
estimand: probability that fresh model fit with random training seed repeats fixed reference class on a fixed case
multiplicity: Bonferroni per fixed dataset-model-split cell over held-out test cases (n_test)
evidence: exact one-sided Clopper-Pearson lower probability bound; score is never a bound on correctness
claim_limitation: PRNG-generated seeds approximate an IID seed sampler; formal model-based coverage presumes independent uniform seeds, which a fixed deterministic PRNG trace cannot guarantee. Data and model family chosen after A01/A02/A03.
